performance_claim: NONE — data is a validation slice; no edge is claimed.
positioning: CHAMPION V2 / ALL-IN PREGAME TOTALS (Leon, 2026-07-07): the board's PICK PRODUCT is the champion_v2 stream below — the champion's own live totals engine + the +EV/vig gate at the REAL latest per-side price (a priced-out champion pick renders as PASS, never a bet), champion-edge star tiers (4-star ceiling). The v4 model grid is TOTALS-ONLY (spread/ML surfaces removed); it remains star-capped by walk evidence with -EV a hard PASS. NOT the champion's pregame_picks Supabase path; the champion engine continues untouched — V2 only reads its stores. Keep the honest record prominent.

champion_v2.what: CHAMPION V2 — the board's pick product: the champion's own live totals engine (unchanged) + V4 serving discipline (+EV/vig gate at the real latest per-side price, star tiers by the champion's own edge size, nightly grading). PREGAME TOTALS ONLY.
champion_v2.star_basis: STAR SYSTEM v3 (Leon, 2026-07-07): RATE EVERY GAME — every row carries 1-5 stars, an always-populated lean={side,line}, a continuous 0-5 score, and playable=(stars>=2). 1 star = WE WOULD PASS (the lean is still stated, clearly labeled Pass): rows that fail the +EV gate at the real latest per-side price, and the toxic tail |edge| >= 0.065 — measured ANTI-signal on the champion's own graded 2022-2026 history (33-43, hit 43.4%, ROI -17.1%; 947 graded picks, 892 decided, day-clustered 95% bootstrap CIs — v4/serve/STAR_CALIBRATION.md). Playable tiers are the MEASURED divergence bands: 4 stars = Tier A 0.04 <= |edge| < 0.065, the sweet spot (248-153, hit 61.8% [57.1-66.5], ROI +17.6% [+8.6..+26.5], ROI-positive every season 2022-2026); 3 stars = 0.03-0.04 (234-177, hit 56.9% [52.4-61.6], ROI +8.7% [-0.0..+17.8]); 2 stars = the smallest playable edges, |edge| < 0.03 past the +EV gate (Tier B lives here — only 4 graded decided picks ever, thin history, lowest playable conviction). The +EV gate is the PLAYABLE boundary: a -EV row can NEVER be 2 stars or better. CEILING 4 stars — the champion is NOT BH-certified on the v4 sealed walk (dev-null on re-derivation), so 5 stars stays reserved for BH-certified cells. score = stars + a within-band blend of edge size and EV (score = stars + 0.99*(0.5*pos_edge + 0.5*pos_ev); pos_edge = |edge| position inside the star's measured band (tail inverted — deeper anti-signal scores lower); pos_ev = EV position (playable: EV_MIN..0.10 -> 0..1; passes: -0.10..EV_MIN -> 0..1, no price -> 0). Monotone blend; score never crosses a star boundary.)
model_notes: DEV-NULL (2026-07-07, v4/models/UNIFIED_TOTALS.md): the champion's edge does NOT reproduce when re-derived on the Odds-API 5-DP odds table — the champion-style path graded flat (+0.1% on 283 dev picks, 2022-25) and the V4 GBM residual path was actively anti-signal at high divergence (-16.6%). CHAMPION V2 therefore uses the champion's OWN pipeline (its snapshot stack + frozen model + frozen policy) as the pick source; V4 adds serving-time discipline (+EV gate at the real latest per-side price, star tiers, nightly grading) — it does NOT re-derive the signal.

HABITAT EROSION WARNING: the champion's trigger habitat — cross-book totals dispersion — is structurally shrinking: T-3h line_std 0.126 (2023) -> 0.096 (2024) -> 0.083 (2025) -> 0.076 (2026); share of slates with >=2 distinct lines 67% -> 48% -> 43% -> 39%; books quoted 16.7 -> 11.7 -> 10.9 -> 11.0. Expect fewer qualifying picks over time. The record display is the ongoing proof either way — no edge is presumed.

STAR RECALIBRATION (2026-07-07, v4/serve/STAR_CALIBRATION.md): star tiers were re-fit to the champion's own measured 2022-2026 bucket win-rates (day-clustered CIs). The edge-ROI gradient is NOT monotone — it is an inverted U: 0.03-0.04 hit 56.9% ROI +8.7%; 0.04-0.065 hit 61.8% ROI +17.6%; >= 0.065 hit 43.4% ROI -17.1% (extreme divergence is where the champion is most WRONG, not most right; sweet-spot-vs-tail ROI gap +34.8pp, 95% CI +11.4..+58.1). Stars therefore peak at 0.04-0.065 and the >= 0.065 tail is demoted out of the playable tiers.

STAR SYSTEM v3 (2026-07-07, same day, Leon): rate EVERY game — no empty cells. 1 star now MEANS 'we would pass' (the lean side+line is still shown); the toxic >= 0.065 tail is a 1-star PASS, no longer a bet, so the headline record is over the PLAYABLE (2-4 star) set. Tier B moved from a 1-star lean to 2 stars: it clears the +EV gate below 0.03 divergence — playable at the lowest conviction, on thin history (4 graded decided picks ever), not on proven skill. Every row carries a continuous 0-5 `score` (stars + within-band edge/EV blend) and the payloads expose per-day featured_game_id = the highest score of the day (playable first; all-pass days feature the best lean, flagged).

gated_out.note: rows rated 1-star PASS under star v3 (fail the +EV gate at the real per-side price, or sit in the measured >=0.065 anti-signal tail). Shown on the board with their lean, never bet; their would-have record is informational only. would_have_record covers ONLY the n_graded rows with a win/loss/push result; n_pending_or_no_result rows are counted here explicitly and excluded from the counterfactual record — never silently dropped.

star_basis.note: STAR SYSTEM v3: every row is rated 1-5 (1* = rated PASS with its lean stated; no empty cells) and carries a continuous 0-5 `score` + `playable` + `lean`.
